headline: Goal: rebuild Mark Kaizen GTA VI-style 9:16 teaser v2 — interactive, "inside the game" tour of user's room, no repeated
summary: Old teaser diagnosed: 6 unique stills repeated, static HUD, oversaturated purple. Built v2 in produccion/teaser-gta-cuarto/render.py (Pillow+numpy+ffmpeg): 7 distinct illustrated scenes (door, desk/PC, window+message, poster wall+neon, closet/hoodie, selfie with user's face, CTA), reactive HUD (objective checks, money, stars, minimap, [E] prompts), soft grade, grain, whip-pan cuts, synthesized audio, loop flash. Output 16.6 s, ~6 MB. Committed and pushed to ccr-948b53da-wiqbwz; no PR.
